description: This file defines Sass functions and mixins related to responsive breakpoints for Bootstrap, including calculations for next, min, max, infix, and media queries for various viewport sizes.

methods.name: breakpoint-next
methods.description: Returns the next breakpoint name after the given breakpoint.

methods.name: breakpoint-min
methods.description: Returns the minimum width value for the specified breakpoint.

methods.name: breakpoint-max
methods.description: Returns the maximum width value for the specified breakpoint.

methods.name: breakpoint-infix
methods.description: Returns a suffix string for the breakpoint used in utility classes, empty for the smallest breakpoint.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-up
methods.description: Mixin that applies styles for viewports equal to or larger than the specified breakpoint.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-down
methods.description: Mixin that applies styles for viewports equal to or smaller than the specified breakpoint.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-between
methods.description: Mixin that applies styles between two breakpoints.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-only
methods.description: Mixin that applies styles only within a specific breakpoint range.
